title: Kits
loading_failed: The kit catalogue could not be read: {error}
empty: No kits in the catalogue yet.
no_matches: No kit matches the search or the filters.
contents_unavailable: What is inside this kit cannot be read from this Studio yet.
sec_screens_hint: Each level it puts screens on, as the shell's tab bar: the kit's tabs highlighted. Pick one to see the screen.
sec_types: What it adds to the model
sec_types_hint: Its types and the types of the Studio domain model they relate to. Pick a type for its fields.
sec_permissions_hint: What it reads, writes and listens to; approved at install, held by the PDP.
description_platform: Base kits: what the platform installs for every organization. An organization adds kits for itself on its own Kits tab, a project on its own.
description_organization: Kits for this organization: install what it needs on top of the base kits. The base kits are the platform's and stay.
description_project: Kits for this project only, on top of what the platform and the organization installed.
from_platform: Installed by the platform for every organization
add_open: Add a kit from a repository
add_title: Add a kit from a repository
add_hint: Studio reads the kit's manifest (kit.json, or .cf-studio-kit.toml) in the directory you name, pins it to a commit and puts it on this organization's shelf. Only this organization sees it.
add_no_connections: The organization has no shared GitHub or GitLab connection of its own to read a repository through. Add one under Connections first.
add_ref: Branch, tag or commit (the default branch when empty)
add_slug: Kit (only when the manifest lists several)
ide_hint: Add templates, workflows and prompts from a material kit to the project's checkouts. Each installation is pinned to a Git version.
ide_no_session: The project's IDE is not running, so its repositories are unknown: a kit is recorded now and written into the project repository. Open the IDE and press Refresh to choose another repository.
ide_repositories_failed: The IDE's repositories could not be read: {error}
ide_install_no_session: Recorded, but not written: the project's IDE is not running ({error}). Open the IDE and install again.
ide_empty: No official kits in this Studio's catalogue. The project works without kits meanwhile.
ide_remove_confirm: Remove from this project? Files it already wrote stay in the repositories until they are removed there.
sec_agents: What it lets people and agents do
sec_agents_hint: What it adds to the Inbox, what an agent can do with it, and the gears it calls.
sec_more_hint: Rules and functions, services, files it writes into a project, artifact kinds.
map_tab_new: Not on the bar yet: appears once the kit is installed
map_model_tab: A tab the model adds: it lists {target}
map_no_route: No screen in this portal yet
map_no_picture: No picture of this screen yet: the next build of the portal takes one.
map_picture_alt: The {label} screen, as the latest build drew it
model_more: {count} more types are in the list
model_diagram_label: The kit's types and the types they relate to
model_no_fields: The kit declares no fields on it.
changes_adopts: Types it adopts from the core
changes_adopts_hint: Types Studio's core already has: an organization keeps its definition and its objects, and one left dormant becomes active again as this kit's.
kind_runtime_hint: Brings its own code that runs in Studio: screens loaded at run time from its own bundles, WebAssembly or agent functions, or a service of its own.
kind_gears_hint: Built on Studio's gears: its screens are Studio's own and its data is held by the gears it claims and calls.
kind_model_hint: Types, fields and rules only, no code: Studio's generic screens show its objects.
kind_material_hint: Working material only: files cfs writes into a project's checkout (templates, workflows, rules).
sec_contents_hint: What the kit is made of: its manifest as kit.gdl, the files to download, its types, the tools, routes and gears it uses.
contents_gdl_rendered: kit.gdl is rendered from {from}: the kit has no authored kit.gdl yet.
contents_gdl_authored: kit.gdl is the kit's own, as authored.
contents_download_failed: The file could not be downloaded: {error}
contents_read_failed: The file could not be read: {error}
